title: I'm a solo dev and fantasy football player, so I made a deckbuilder where real NFL stats power your cards
author: No-Pomegranate-6593
selftext:
Here the speech, since I'm a french NFL fan and gamer, I was thinking since years to make a small game about fantasy football that doesn't exist yet. Here it is, a Balatro-like inspired  
deckbuilder "roguelite" fantasy football game (a pretty long description sorry).

About me, and AI : I'm solo (backend) dev, AI assisted and I don't want to hide it. In this project, AI was used for pixel art animations and some frontend ajustments. The game concept, engine, rules and balance are my own design.

The current visual interface—across web, mobile, and desktop—serves solely to facilitate testing; however, I am working (with less AI involvement) on a native mobile application, following a clearly defined (and perhaps overly long) roadmap.

I hope you’ll give it a try and that you enjoy it. A quick heads-up: since this is a game centered on "fantasy football" (NFL), it requires some knowledge of the subject.

link: [https://beta.cutday.app](https://beta.cutday.app/)

Thanks,

Patrice.
